thought.text: The `.home` file for Studio ≥4.1 goes **directly** in the versioned marker dir. Fixing:

reasoning_content:
Important discovery: On Linux, when `flutter config --android-studio-dir` is set, it uses `configuredStudioDir` as the directory, and **the version is taken from an already-discovered studio** (or null if none is found). In other words:

Option A: Fix the marker: for major>=4.1, `.home` is placed directly at `/root/.cache/Google/AndroidStudio2026.2.1.8/.home` (not inside `system/`). Then `fromHomeDot` can find it and get version 2026.2.1.8.

Option B: Set `flutter config --android-studio-dir=/opt/android-studio` → directory = /opt/android-studio, version = null (since there's no matching discovery) → again "version unknown".

Option A is correct. Move the .home file to the top level of the marker directory.

action.command: echo "/opt/android-studio" > /root/.cache/Google/AndroidStudio2026.2.1.8/.home && rm -rf /root/.cache/Google/AndroidStudio2026.2.1.8/system && export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && cd /workspace && fvm flutter doctor -v 2>&1 | grep -v "Woah\|superuser" | sed -n '/Android Studio/,/^$/p'; echo "exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"/opt/android-studio\" > /root/.cache/Google/AndroidStudio2026.2.1.8/.home && rm -rf /root/.cache/Google/AndroidStudio2026.2.1.8/system && export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk && cd /workspace && fvm flutter doctor -v 2>&1 | grep -v \"Woah\\|superuser\" | sed -n '/Android Studio/,/^$/p'; echo \"exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Fix .home marker location and re-check doctor"}

summary: Fix .home marker location and re-check doctor
